title: Security Hub - How Do We Coordinate Ethereum Security?
description:
How can we better coordinate Ethereum security efforts and make sure the right work gets funded?

In this session, we'll introduce the Security Hub at Devcon, discuss the coordination challenges facing Ethereum security, and share what TheDAO aims to achieve through the ETHSecurity Initiatives Round.

We'll also invite the audience to experiment with live voting on initiatives in the round using Blossom Budgeting, exploring how we can collectively identify priorities and direct funding where it's needed most.
